card.name: Ordinal words before day or dose
card.fires_on: Words like next, first, one, same, or multiple that come right before a count noun such as day, night, injection, or doses. Mostly in dosing and missed-dose instructions.

modes.label: Same/next/first day or night
modes.description: A time word such as same, next, or first that comes before day, night, or Sunday in a dosing schedule.
modes.example: They should not take two doses on the<< same>> day but should return to taking one dose

modes.label: One to the next
modes.description: The word one in from one injection to the next, or in one-time use.
modes.example: • Rotate injection sites within the same region from<< one>> injection to the next to reduce the risk

modes.label: Multiple doses
modes.description: A quantity word before doses or shocks that counts repeated events.
modes.example: generally occur following the administration of<< multiple>> doses.
